name: ai-work-team
title_zh: 讨论、规划、执行三态切换，交接不丢边界
tagline_zh: 项目一深入就乱？它把 AI 协作切成三档：聊想法、排计划、严格落地。换挡时自动保存上下文，范围不漂移，交接不断线。
tagline_en: Tired of AI drifting mid-project? It splits work into discuss, plan, execute—each with strict rules, so handoffs.
desc_en: Route AI-assisted project work between discussion, planning, and strict execution modes while preserving handoffs and scope boundaries.
why_zh: 不是笼统的『AI 助手』，而是显式状态机：讨论时发散、规划时收敛、执行时只认验收标准。
why_en: Not a vague assistant—an explicit state machine. Discuss diverges, plan converges, execute obeys only acceptance criteria. Mode.
limit_zh: 只适用于 AI 辅助的项目流程管理，不接具体行业工具（如 Jira、Trello）。它管『怎么协作』。
limit_en: Only for AI-assisted project workflow; no Jira/Trello integration. It governs how you collaborate, not what you build. Vague tasks still fail—mode.
title_en: Switch modes: discuss, plan, execute, keep handoffs
